text:
Devon Carter: Hi team — after we switched SolaraPay's Key Vault to use a private endpoint and gave the redwood service principal the "Key Vault Crypto User" role on the key, rewraps from your platform now return 403 and we don't see anything in our Azure logs for those attempts. Can you confirm what permissions/audit settings you expect?

Maria Chen: sorry for the trouble — can you paste the exact error payload you see from the rewrap call and the Key Vault resource id? Also confirm whether the vault uses Azure RBAC or Access Policies for keys.

Devon Carter: error snippet:
```
Error: 403 Forbidden
Message: "Key operation not allowed for principal"
RequestId: a1b2c3d4-0000-efgh-5678
```
vault id: /subscriptions/0f12ab34-zzzz-8888/resourceGroups/rg-solara/providers/Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/kv-solara-pay/keys/enc-key

we switched to Azure RBAC (not access policies) and assigned the SP at the key resource with built-in "Key Vault Crypto User".

KMS Eng: two quick things to check:
1) Key Vault Diagnostic Settings — Azure doesn't emit all crypto operations into Activity Log by default. You need KeyVaultAuditEvents (diagnostic logs) routed to Log Analytics/Storage/Event Hub. Without that you won't see wrap/unwrap in your logs.
2) Private Endpoint/DNS — when a private endpoint is used, traffic is inside your VNet. Make sure the redwood outbound IPs/peering are allowed or that a managed identity is used from within your network. DNS should resolve kv-solara-pay.privatelink.vaultcore.windows.net to the private IP.

Maria Chen: sample az to enable diagnostics (send to Log Analytics):
```
az monitor diagnostic-settings create \
  --resource "/subscriptions/<sub>/resourceGroups/<rg>/providers/Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/<vault>" \
  --workspace "/subscriptions/<sub>/resourcegroups/<rg>/providers/microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces/<la>" \
  --name kv-audit --logs '[{"category":"AuditEvent","enabled":true}]'
```
That will surface KeyVaultAuditEvent entries including wrap/unwrap.

Ash (sre): also verify the authorization model on the vault: if the vault is still configured to use "Vault access policy" mode for keys (older model) RBAC role assignments are ignored. Run:
```
az keyvault show -n kv-solara-pay --query properties.enableRbacAuthorization
```
it should be true for RBAC.

Devon Carter: output shows enableRbacAuthorization = true. We do have diagnostic setting set but we routed to a storage account (cold) — I can switch to Log Analytics if that helps.

KMS Eng: storage account is fine for raw events, but Log Analytics is easier to query quickly. Also check that the diagnostic setting includes "AuditEvent" specifically (not only "Request" metadata). If you see events but they show 403, include the principalId and operationName — that will help.

Maria Chen: one more gotcha — if you used a Managed Identity for Redwood instead of a service principal, confirm the identity you're granted matches the identity presented in requests. The request principalId in the KeyVaultAuditEvent must match the principal you granted the role.

Devon Carter: I see events now after enabling to Log Analytics — there are entries but the operationName is Microsoft.KeyVault/keys/wrap/action with status 403 and the "principalName" shows redwood-inference-sp, but principalId doesn't match the SP object id we assigned. Looks like the platform is using a different app id. I'm pasting the event fields:
```
operationName: Microsoft.KeyVault/keys/wrap/action
statusCode: 403
principalName: redwood-inference-sp
principalId: 99999999-aaaa-bbbb-cccc-111111111111
```
ours is 22222222-aaaa-bbbb-cccc-222222222222

Maria Chen: ok that explains it — the role was granted to a different object id. We likely have multiple service principals for hosted vs dedicated. I'll check which App ID we present for your account and share it.

KMS Eng: besides the principal mismatch, also check the key-level permissions: for cross-account rewraps we need both ReEncryptFrom and ReEncryptTo (in AWS terms) — in Azure the important key operations are wrapKey/unwrapKey/encrypt/decrypt. Make sure the assigned role covers crypto operations on that key scope.

Ash (sre): and DNS/network — double-check that any private endpoint NSG doesn't block outbound to the Redwood egress if you're using our hosted endpoints. If you're on Dedicated/Private we may use your network, but confirm.

Maria Chen: we've confirmed for SolaraPay the platform uses app object id 99999999-aaaa-bbbb-cccc-111111111111 for hosted requests. Can you re-run the assignment to that principal and test? If you prefer, we can create a short role assignment script for you.

Devon Carter: will update now. small question for rotation: when we rotate the underlying key (create a new key version) do we need to update any enveloping metadata on S3 objects or is the platform rewrap path sufficient?

KMS Eng: platform supports automated rewrap if it has WrapKey/UnwrapKey on both old and new key versions. Typical flow:
- Redwood calls Unwrap/Decrypt with old key to get plaintext data key
- Generate new data key and Wrap with new key version
- Update envelope metadata on object
If you plan to enforce strict keyVersion in policies, ensure both versions are usable by the service principal during migration.

Maria Chen: checklist we need from you to finish verification:
- confirm role assignment for object id 99999999-aaaa-bbbb-cccc-111111111111 at the key resource scope
- paste one Log Analytics event id for a 403 wrap attempt
- confirm private endpoint DNS resolves from a jumpbox (nslookup kv-solara-pay.privatelink.vaultcore.windows.net)

Devon Carter: assigned the role to the provided object id and re-tested — wrap now returns 200. :tada: I'll send a Log Analytics event id for the previous 403s in the thread DM.

Maria Chen: great, glad that fixed it. We'll follow up with a short doc addendum about private endpoint gotchas and a config snippet for role assignment. Want to schedule a 30m walkthrough to go over rotation and audit forwarding?

Devon Carter: yes please — mornings PST work best. thanks everyone.

audit-bot: Incident INC-2026-042 auto-created: "Customer KMS audit gaps due to RBAC principal mismatch" — assigned to eng-kms. See https://redwood.example/incidents/INC-2026-042

Maria Chen: I'll set up the meeting and attach the checklist and the az role assignment snippet once the invite is out. :thumbsup:
